Definition
[Twice differentiability in the sense of Stolz] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0437 1. apph:H.7\group Euclidean convexity For an open $U\subset \R ^n$, a continuous $f$ is twice differentiable in the sense of Stolz at $x$ if there are a vector $W$ and symmetric matrix $M$ such that \[ f(x+y)=f(x)+W\cdot y+M(y,y)+o(|y|^2). \]
